_readme: More Client Work — the gallery under the three featured projects. Edit this file only; the page reads it.
Every entry is a project Waqar published on Behance or Contra (titles, links and facts copied from those pages).
Thumbnails: 'thumb.local' is a self-hosted copy in /public/work/more (create it with `npm run thumbs`, which downloads
'thumb.remote' and optimises it). Until the local file exists the page shows the published image from 'thumb.remote'.
Optional: 'caseStudy' = slug of a case-study page on this site; 'accent' = project colour (else read from the thumbnail).
Only fill 'client', 'role', 'tools' and 'live' with facts stated on the published project page.
